events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Kevin Gausman pitched 5 2/3 innings for his first win since May 22, George Springer had two hits and drove in a pair, and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gausman gets first win since May 22, Springer drives in two as Blue Jays beat Cardinals 5-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.shortLinkText: Rasmussen, Fortes, Baker power the AL-leading Rays to a 1-0 win over the White Sox

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Javier Sanoja and Griffin Conine homered to power the Miami Marlins to a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanoja, Conine homer to help the Marlins beat the Mets 6-2

headlines.description: — Randy Arozarena scored in the ninth inning on Cal Raleigh's groundout to first base, and the Seattle Mariners snapped a three-game losing streak with a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arozarena scores in 9th as Mariners snap losing streak with 4-3 win over Twins

headlines.description: — Braxton Ashcraft gave up two hits over five innings, while a pair of bases-loaded walks during a three-run third helped the Pittsburgh Pirates snap a four-game losing streak with a 4-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates beat Reds 4-1 to snap four-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sánchez struck out 11 in six innings, helping the Philadelphia Phillies snap their four-game losing streak with a 5-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sánchez strikes out 11, works around walks as Phillies snap 4-game skid with 5-0 win over Orioles

headlines.description: — Taylor Trammell had two RBI and Christian Walker added two hits and drove in a run to held give the Houston Astros a 5-4 victory over the Texas Rangers Saturday night that increased their lead in the AL West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros edge Rangers 5-4, stretching AL West lead with 5th straight win

headlines.description: — Geraldo Perdomo and Corbin Carroll homered during a seven-run seventh inning, and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Cleveland Guardians 12-8 on Saturday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perdomo, Carroll homer in 7-run 7th in Diamondbacks' 12-8 win over the Guardians

headlines.description: — Martín Pérez held Washington hitless until the seventh inning, Ronald Acuña Jr., Matt Olson and Dominic Smith hit home runs, and the Atlanta...
headlines.shortLinkText: Martín Pérez flirts with a no-hitter as Braves power past Nationals 8-3

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong drove in the go-ahead run with a seventh-inning triple and scored twice as the Chicago Cubs evened their series with the New York Yankees with a 5-2 win on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Crow-Armstrong's go-ahead triple lifts Cubs to 5-2 win over Yankees

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Hunter Goodman homered twice, had two singles and drove in five runs in the Colorado Rockies' 12-6 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goodman homers twice, drives in 5 runs in Rockies' 12-6 victory over Royals

events.name: San Francisco Giants at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jake Cronenworth singled in Xander Bogaerts with two outs in the ninth inning and the San Diego Padres beat the San Francisco Giants 6-5 on Saturday night for their seventh win in eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cronenworth's single gives Padres 6-5 win over Giants after Miller blows save

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Andruw Monasterio hit a ground-rule double to lead off the eighth and scored the go-ahead run on Connor Wong's double-play grounder as the streaking Boston Red Sox edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafaela hits 2 homers as streaking Red Sox take lead in 8th and edge Yamamoto and Dodgers 3-2

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Brice Turang had a go-ahead RBI single in the eighth inning and the Milwaukee Brewers finished off a 3-1 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers beat Angels 3-1 to move past Dodgers for MLB lead

headlines.shortLinkText: Max Clark hits his first career homer to lead the Tigers past the A's 8-6
